Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Class StreamBuilder

java.lang.Object
ke.ric.renderer.api.StreamBuilder
public final class StreamBuilder extends Object
Immutable live-camera configuration. Each modifier returns a new builder. Call start() on the server thread after adding at least one frame consumer, palette sink or output.

Defaults are Classic 128×128, 70° vertical FOV, zero roll, a 16-block radius and a target of 20 FPS. Smooth mode can reuse unchanged world evidence for at most 500 ms and two blocks of camera movement within the original centre chunk. fresh() requests new evidence for every frame. FPS is a target: obsolete frames are discarded and work never queues to catch up.

Streams share a fair capture coordinator with four chunks per server tick and bounded conversion work. Each stream has at most one render/conversion in progress. Required chunks must already be loaded. Maps are allocated once and updated, never saved as photographs. After one second without a usable frame, built-in outputs show “No signal” until recovery.

Camera and environment suppliers, frame/error/progress callbacks and Bukkit mutations run on the server thread. Source death/logout, a null camera supplier, owner disable, provider replacement or affected world unload ends or fails the feed. Partial output setup is rolled back, and cleanup removes only owned temporary output.


 RenderStream stream = renderer.stream(drone)
         .toScreen(upperLeftBackingBlock, BlockFace.NORTH, 2, 2)
         .toPlayer(operator)
         .onError(error -> plugin.getLogger().warning(error.getMessage()))
         .start();
 // Later:
 stream.stop();

    • fps

      public StreamBuilder fps(int fps)
      Sets a target frame rate. Slow work skips frames instead of queuing catch-up requests; actual throughput depends on capture, rendering, resolution, conversion and server load.
      Parameters:
      fps - target from 1 to 20 inclusive; default 20
      Returns:
      a new builder with this target
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if fps is outside 1..20

    • resolution

      public StreamBuilder resolution(int width, int height)
      Sets explicit render dimensions. The immutable original builder is unchanged. Each map or screen preserves image aspect ratio with black letterboxing. This overrides resolution inference from a screen grid.
      Parameters:
      width - positive output width in pixels
      height - positive output height in pixels
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid dimensions

    • profile

      public StreamBuilder profile(RenderSettings.Profile profile)
      Selects rendering quality. Check the active provider's advertised profiles before choosing a profile; explicit requested lights and shadows are not silently disabled by quality.
      Parameters:
      profile - supported quality profile; default CLASSIC
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting

    • settings

      public StreamBuilder settings(RenderSettings settings)
      Replaces rendering settings, including resolution, profile, attachments, memory and timeout. Camera FOV, roll, capture radius and recipe controls remain as configured. Its dimensions count as an explicit resolution and disable screen-grid inference.
      Parameters:
      settings - complete immutable render settings
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting

    • fov

      public StreamBuilder fov(double degrees)
      Sets vertical field of view, changing the camera framing rather than image brightness. The default is 70°. Older providers explicitly reject unsupported custom FOV.
      Parameters:
      degrees - finite vertical angle strictly between 0 and 180
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting
      Throws:

    • radius

      public StreamBuilder radius(double blocks)
      Sets how far loaded-world evidence is captured around the source camera. Larger radii increase capture and render work; required chunks must already be loaded.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting
      Throws:

    • fresh

      public StreamBuilder fresh()
      Requests newly captured world evidence for every frame. The resulting camera pose is the pose used for that capture; smooth mode instead reframes recent evidence for a newer pose.
      Returns:
      a new builder with scene reuse disabled

    • reuse

      public StreamBuilder reuse(SceneReusePolicy policy)
      Enables smooth camera reframing with bounded evidence age and displacement. Neither limit is renewed by reuse. The camera must stay in the captured centre chunk and covered build height.
      Parameters:
      policy - immutable reuse bounds; defaults are 500 ms and two blocks
      Returns:
      a new builder with scene reuse enabled

    • reuse

      public StreamBuilder reuse(Duration maxWorldAge, double maxCameraDisplacement)
      Enables smooth camera reframing against unchanged captured world evidence. A fresh capture is needed when its age, displacement or original centre-chunk coverage is exceeded.
      Parameters:
      maxWorldAge - positive duration that fits in nanoseconds, measured from original capture
      maxCameraDisplacement - finite nonnegative distance from the original capture pose, in blocks
      Returns:
      a new builder with these reuse bounds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid bounds

      Adds one temporary handheld map in a free inventory slot without replacing items. The image preserves aspect ratio with black letterboxing. A full inventory fails setup; disconnect removes this output. The map is updated in place and does not enter the saved-photo store.
      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • toScreen

      public StreamBuilder toScreen(org.bukkit.Location anchor, org.bukkit.block.BlockFace face, int columns, int rows)
      Adds a temporary wall screen made of owned item frames. The anchor is the upper-left backing block as viewed from the requested outward face; columns extend right and rows extend down. The wall and frame positions are validated at start. Partial setup is rolled back, and stop removes only owned output. Existing item frames are rejected.

      Unless resolution was explicitly set, this screen sets render dimensions to columns×128 by rows×128. Multiple screens use the last inferred resolution. Outputs fit the final image to their own grid without distorting its aspect ratio. Live maps are never persisted as photos.

      Parameters:
      anchor - copied location of the upper-left backing block
      face - NORTH, SOUTH, EAST or WEST, pointing outward from the backing wall
      columns - grid width, 1..16 maps
      rows - grid height, 1..16 maps; total at most 256
      Returns:
      a new builder with this screen
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for an unsupported face or grid size

    • start

      public RenderStream start()
      Starts the configured feed on the server thread and allocates its temporary outputs once. At least one output, palette sink or frame consumer is required. Setup failure rolls back partial output creation. Owner disable also stops this stream automatically.
      Returns:
      the lifecycle handle; stop it when the feed is no longer needed
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if called off the server thread or no destination is configured
      RendererException - if the owner/provider is unavailable or setup cannot complete

      Rotates the camera around its viewing axis. Camera-relative lights follow the same roll. The default is zero; this convenience method uses degrees, while SceneCamera uses radians.
      Parameters:
      degrees - any finite roll angle, including full turns and inverted views
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if degrees is nonfinite

      public StreamBuilder lighting(RenderLighting value)
      Sets request-level world and explicit lighting. Layers inherit this setup unless they supply their own complete lighting value. Exposure and post-render brightness are separate controls.
      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • onProgress

      public StreamBuilder onProgress(Consumer<FrameProgress> value)
      Observes measured stage-local work on the server thread, at most once per tick. Updates are coalesced; stages and render passes can restart at zero. Percentage is basisPoints / 100.0. Keep the callback quick. Throwing fails pending work; a final coalesced notification may arrive after successful completion and cannot revoke it. Lifecycle checks suppress callbacks after cancellation or owner/provider invalidation.
      Parameters:
      value - nonnull progress observer
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting

    • content

      public StreamBuilder content(SceneContent value)
      Selects which captured block/entity geometry remains available to each render pass. Removed geometry cannot contribute to camera, reflection or shadow rays; sampled environment and light levels remain. Entity layers can instead restrict camera output while retaining scene geometry. Use excluding(...) to omit entities before capture.
      Parameters:
      value - immutable selection; default SceneContent.all()
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting

    • appearance

      public StreamBuilder appearance(RenderAppearance value)
      Sets rendering appearance, including exposure. Exposure is applied by the renderer; layer brightness is a separate multiplication of already rendered pixels.
      Parameters:
      value - immutable appearance overrides; unspecified fields inherit captured values
      Returns:
      a new builder with this setting

    • environment

      Returns:
